Usage: spec-driven-steroids package [options]

Render the portable Agent Plugin package and the marketplace catalogs

Options:
  --out <dir>            Directory the distribution tree is written to
  --owner <owner>        Marketplace owner name
  --name <name>          Portable package name
  --description <text>   Package description
  --author <author>      Package author
  --icon <icon>          Package icon path
  --category <category>  Marketplace category
  --mcp <path>           Optional MCP configuration file
  --dry-run              Compute the tree without writing it
  --json                 Emit a machine-readable JSON summary
  -h, --help             display help for command
